name: provenmap
description: ProvenMap plugins for codebase and knowledge architecture analysis, visualization, and sync to ProvenMap Portal.

metadata.description: ProvenMap plugins for codebase and knowledge architecture analysis, visualization, and sync to ProvenMap Portal.

plugins.name: pmap-code
plugins.description: Real-time codebase architecture analysis and visualization for ProvenMap Portal. Analyzes codebases across multiple languages, detects tech stacks, identifies component relationships, and syncs to ProvenMap for collaborative architecture boards. Supports server-defined insight analysis skills.

plugins.name: pmap-work
plugins.description: Knowledge and document architecture analysis for ProvenMap Portal. Analyzes a document/knowledge set — specs, RFCs, policies, design docs, wikis — into a graph of concepts, documents, decisions, and their relationships, and syncs to ProvenMap for collaborative knowledge boards. Tuned for knowledge-work surfaces — Claude Cowork and Codex for Work. Supports server-defined insight analysis skills.

plugins.name: pmap-arch
plugins.description: Architect workbench for ProvenMap boards — explore the board graph, review insights, and author intents from Claude Cowork, Claude Code, or Codex. Connects to the ProvenMap MCP server; writes gather in your working copy, and committing mints a reviewable plan (one intent per governed app).
